title: Enterprise Connectivity: physical metering
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity governs physical metering for primary meter, primary meter reversal, ancillary meter.

## Policy clause 1
The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity.

## Policy clause 2
Meters originate in the provider resource export.

## Policy clause 3
Primary meter quantities use primary consumption unit; a meter is positive and a meter reversal is the negative of the exact erroneous source quantity, capped by the source quantity not already reversed.

## Policy clause 4
Keep original interval, region, configuration and source reference. actual measured billing overage permits measured quantities above generic monthly included volume; no service entitlement is invented by a meter write.

## Policy clause 5
Round measured quantities to measured-volume decimal places using rounding convention, apply minimum interval volume and round positive billable primary quantities upward to a whole billable volume increment.

## Policy clause 6
Stopped or suspended service accrues no primary running usage, but real retained storage and other supplemental services remain billable through ancillary meter.

## Policy clause 7
A rejected or cancelled source is not a billable meter.

## Policy clause 8
Repeated exports with the same resource, meter, interval and correction reference are read-only confirmations.

## Evidence condition 1
For primary meter, primary meter reversal, ancillary meter, the authoritative system record must establish this condition before the action: The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity. The evidence consists of evidence-event identifier, external reference, interval beginning, interval ending, quantity. Correlate the same evidence-event identifier to the transaction being handled; a customer statement does not substitute for this record.

## Points of judgement
Repeated exports with the same resource, meter, interval and correction reference are read-only confirmations.

## Tier references
The contract tier supplies the primary consumption unit, measured-volume decimal places, rounding convention, billable volume increment, minimum interval volume, overage treatment, generic monthly included volume used by this rule.

## Record identity: primary meter
A signed primary consumption delta is recorded against the source resource interval. One source resource interval, accounting line, or independently referenced service occurrence; derived lines retain the narrowest original event reference. Its business identity distinguishes external reference, source-event reference, related-review reference, period, meter type, source classification, interval beginning, interval ending.

## Record identity: primary meter reversal
A signed primary consumption delta is recorded against the source resource interval. One source resource interval, accounting line, or independently referenced service occurrence; derived lines retain the narrowest original event reference. Its business identity distinguishes external reference, source-event reference, related-review reference, period, meter type, source classification, interval beginning, interval ending.
